concerns.text: Task T006.1 defines the 'register_participant' function but fails to mandate the verification of the OSF instrument code (SART/Ospan v2.1+) against a reference hash before data generation. Plan Phase 0 Step 1b and Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) require this verification step to ensure scoring logic integrity. The task only validates ID patterns, silently weakening the 'Verified Accuracy' constraint.

Task T033.1 implements the bootstrapping loop but lacks an explicit verification step to ensure the code does NOT use Shapiro-Wilk to trigger a fallback. Plan 'Critical Methodological Note' and FR-006 explicitly forbid data-dependent switching. Without a task to verify this constraint (e.g., a unit test asserting the absence of Shapiro-Wilk logic), the task risks silently relaxing the statistical protocol.

Task T037 generates the statistical summary JSON but does not include a verification step to compare results against Success Criteria (SC-001 to SC-005) thresholds (p < 0.05, d ≥ 0.2). The spec requires these comparisons to determine 'success'. The task delivers the data but drops the acceptance criterion of validating the outcome against the defined success thresholds.

Task T008 configures random seed management but lacks a verification step to ensure the final pipeline execution logs the exact seed used and canonical source URLs in a 'reproducibility_manifest.json'. Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires results to be reproducible on a fresh runner; without a manifest logging the seed and sources, this constitutional constraint is not preserved in the deliverable.

Tasks T038.1 and T038.2 are duplicated in Phase 3 and Phase 5 with conflicting statuses (one marked `[ ]` incomplete, one `[X]` complete). This ambiguity prevents the verification of FR-011 (Sensitivity Analysis). The task list fails to clearly define the deliverable state for the sensitivity analysis, risking a silent drop of the requirement to document self-report limitations.

Task T010 (Monte Carlo Power Simulation) is referenced as a dependency in T040 and T056 but is marked as 'rejected' or 'redo' in the footer, with no active, verifiable replacement task ID. The Plan Phase 0 Step 6 requires this simulation. The current task list fails to preserve the requirement for a valid power simulation artifact, creating a gap in the statistical validation chain.
